ui.home.intro.title: A small tool for checking what is actually public.
ui.home.intro.body: SocialScope takes one TikTok or Instagram link, validates it, then shows what can genuinely be reached: official embeds for content, structured data for public Stories. No account, no platform session, and nothing invented.
ui.home.intro.who.1: Social media teams tracking competitors' public content.
ui.home.intro.who.2: Creators checking how their own public Story appears.
ui.home.intro.who.3: Anyone who wants to know which parts of a link are truly public.
ui.home.value.1.title: Status per feature
ui.home.value.1.body: Every capability is labelled supported, embed-only, or unavailable. Platform limits are never hidden behind a button that looks like it works.
ui.home.value.2.title: Your URL is never fetched
ui.home.value.2.body: The link is validated, then discarded. Outbound requests are built from fixed templates plus a checked identifier, and redirects are always refused.
ui.home.value.3.title: No account, no session
ui.home.value.3.body: There is no login form and no platform session in use. Every limit we cannot guarantee is stated openly on the Privacy page.

ui.steps.title: From paste to render.
ui.steps.1.title: Paste a link
ui.steps.1.body: Enter a profile, Story, video, post, or reel URL. Short links such as vm.tiktok.com are not supported because we refuse redirects.
ui.steps.2.title: We validate it
ui.steps.2.body: Scheme, exact host, port, and path shape are checked on the server. Your URL is never fetched; outbound requests are built from fixed templates.

ui.home.result.show.1: Official embed players for profiles, videos, posts, and reels.
ui.home.result.show.2: Story items: photo or video, upload time, and duration when available.
ui.home.result.show.3: An explicit Story status: active, empty, or failed to load.
ui.home.result.show.4: Mode and source labels on every block, never blended.
ui.home.result.hide.1: Viewer lists and private statistics — only the account owner has access.
ui.home.result.hide.3: Expired Stories, or Stories padded with samples.
ui.home.result.fine: An empty result is not proof the account is private or deleted. The source may simply have returned nothing.
ui.faq.title: Questions that come up often.
ui.faq.1.q: Does SocialScope need an account or login?
ui.faq.1.a: No. There is no sign-up, no password, and no TikTok or Instagram session in use. You only paste a link.
ui.faq.2.a: Only public Stories from public accounts. Private accounts, paid content, and age-restricted content cannot be reached, and we do not try to get around that.
ui.faq.3.a: Stories live for about 24 hours, and a provider can fail or find no items. The result page always states which it was: empty, inactive, or failed.
ui.faq.4.q: Does the creator know I opened their Story?
ui.faq.4.a: We cannot promise anything about that. The viewer list is visible only to the account owner, and a third-party provider may use its own session. We do not claim you are invisible.
ui.faq.5.q: Can I download a video or Story?
ui.faq.5.a: No. SocialScope does not download, store, or rehost media. Media loads in your browser directly from the platform.
ui.faq.6.q: What data goes to the provider?
ui.faq.6.a: Only a username or Story ID from our server. Your IP and browser user agent are not forwarded to the Story provider. Details are on the Privacy page.
ui.disclaimer.title: Not an official platform product.
ui.disclaimer.body: SocialScope is an independent project and is not affiliated with TikTok, Instagram, or Meta. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
ui.disclaimer.1: We only show content returned by permitted sources, and we never access private accounts.
ui.disclaimer.2: Feature availability depends on platform policy and documentation, which can change at any time.
ui.disclaimer.3: We make no privacy guarantee that the code cannot prove.
ui.privacy.band.title: No login. Not invisible.
ui.privacy.band.body: We never ask for a password, never reuse platform sessions, and never forward your IP to the Story service. Third-party services may use their own session, and we cannot verify the creator's viewer list.

ui.error.title: Request not completed
ui.error.tips.title: What you can try
ui.error.tips.1: Make sure the URL starts with https:// and uses tiktok.com or instagram.com.
ui.error.tips.2: For Stories, use a profile URL or a Story URL that is still active.
ui.error.tips.3: Short links such as vm.tiktok.com or /s/ are unsupported because SocialScope refuses redirects.
ui.error.tips.4: If you just tried several times, wait a minute and retry.
ui.error.fine: We never show internal details, upstream bodies, headers, or query strings on the error page.
ui.privacy.lede: This page explains what SocialScope processes, what it sends elsewhere, and what we cannot guarantee.
ui.privacy.claims.title: Three things often confused
ui.privacy.claim.1.title: No login
ui.privacy.claim.1.body: You never create a SocialScope account and never enter a TikTok or Instagram password. The product has no credential form at all.
ui.privacy.claim.2.title: No visitor identity sent to the provider
ui.privacy.claim.2.body: Story lookup runs on our server. The provider receives a username or Story ID, not your IP or browser user agent. Media still loads in your browser from the platform.
ui.privacy.claim.3.title: Absent from the viewer list
ui.privacy.claim.3.body: Only the account owner sees the viewer list, and we have no access to it. A third-party provider may use its own session, so we cannot verify whether your activity is recorded.
ui.privacy.data.title: Data processed
ui.privacy.data.1.b: Validated locally, then discarded. The original URL is never fetched.
ui.privacy.data.2.b: Sent to the Story provider as a lookup parameter.
ui.privacy.data.2.c: No, beyond a short memory cache
ui.privacy.data.3.b: Normalized into displayed fields. Media is not proxied.
ui.privacy.data.3.c: Short memory cache (45 seconds by default)
ui.privacy.data.4.b: Used for per-visitor rate limiting, hashed.
ui.privacy.data.5.b: Events and error types only. No URL, query string, body, header, or media URL.
ui.privacy.data.5.c: Not written to disk by the app
ui.privacy.data.6.b: Story photos and videos load in your browser directly from the platform. No media proxy on the SocialScope server.
ui.privacy.third.title: Third-party services
ui.privacy.third.body: TikTok and Instagram content renders through the platform's official embed, loaded by your browser straight from the platform domain; SocialScope does not read inside that iframe. For Stories, the item data comes from third-party services called by our server: one public API for TikTok and one metered, per-unit API for Instagram. SocialScope does not control their policies, availability, or internals.
ui.privacy.third.note: Instagram Story calls are metered per unit and capped daily on the server. TikTok Stories use a public API with no key. Configuration lives only in the server environment and is never sent to the browser.
ui.privacy.never.title: What we never do
ui.privacy.never.1: Ask for a password, verification code, or platform identity.
ui.privacy.never.3: Rotate proxies, change IPs, or bypass CAPTCHA/anti-bot checks.
ui.privacy.never.4: Scrape platform HTML or use internal systems.
ui.privacy.never.6: Sell, combine, or mine data for analytics.
ui.privacy.limits.title: Limits you should know
ui.privacy.limits.1: A provider failure is not proof the account is private, deleted, or missing.
ui.privacy.limits.2: Usage limits and the cache live in process memory; a server restart resets both.
ui.privacy.limits.3: Instagram Story quota is metered per unit and capped daily. Once it runs out, Instagram Stories cannot be shown until quota returns.
ui.privacy.limits.4: Hosting infrastructure may log standard requests (IP, time, path) outside application control.
ui.privacy.limits.5: No database, no search history, and no "recently viewed" feature.
ui.privacy.limits.6: Content inside official embeds still belongs to the platform and can change or disappear without notice.
ui.privacy.fine: This document describes application behavior, not legal advice. Provider availability and platform terms may change.
ui.meta.description: SocialScope shows public TikTok and Instagram Stories and public content through official embeds and permitted sources, with capability limits stated plainly.
